content.about: Laos is the only landlocked country in Southeast Asia, shaped by forested mountains and the Mekong River. Its towns are quiet, with gold-roofed temples and monks walking at dawn to collect alms. Luang Prabang is a well-preserved royal city. The mysterious Plain of Jars holds thousands of ancient stone jars.

standout.text: Khone Phapheng on the Mekong is the largest waterfall in Southeast Asia by volume of water.

didYouKnow: Laos is often called the most bombed country per person in history.
Sticky rice is eaten with almost every meal.
Nobody knows for sure what the giant stone jars were used for.
